notes.title: 星光的引導－世界的巡禮者 商店頁面正式公開
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102010


[h1]星光的引導－世界的巡禮者[/h1] 
商店頁面正式公開，加入願望清單就是現在！

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/fe4da34673cf2459fb6a64cf436adc4bd96e9aea.jpg[/img]


[h1]Story[/h1]
一名來自小村落的少女，拿起星星的手杖，跟著伙伴踏上了旅程。 在旅程中會遇到各種冒險和挑戰，究竟會有什麼在等待著少女呢？

[h1]Character[/h1]
艾莉絲：來自一個小村落的少女，對於這個世界充滿好奇心而踏上旅程

莫爾摩：為了觀察人間界而從魔界過來的「幽靈」少女

斯碧涅爾：代表充實、好奇心、突出為印象的寶石，擁有尖晶石之力的少女

凱洛拉伊：習慣一個人孤獨的少女，遵從自己的野望流浪於世界各處

遊戲中還有更多的角色等著玩家去發掘...


[h1]Feature[/h1]
■ 傳統的回合制RPG遊戲，過程中會有許多角色加入隊伍

■ 豐富的技能與各種敵人，讓玩家可以思考打法與策略

■ 許多可愛的角色，可以跟她們互動

notes.title: Delayed Update Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Delayed Update Announcement:[/b]
Considering that there have been no updates for two consecutive weeks, I feel the need to provide an explanation.

Currently, the Early Access content of The Hearts of Immortality only extends up to Act II.
However, despite the time I’ve spent on development, the main content of Act III consists largely of side quests, which limits the player’s freedom to explore.
This is actually the same situation that occurred during the development of Act II, which was also delayed for a long time.
As such, for the foreseeable future, the game may not receive regular updates for quite some time.
Eventually, once a certain amount of content was completed, Act II was released.

So now I’m considering:
Should I let players access the current state of Act III content?
Or should I wait until more is complete before opening it up for play?

Everyone—could you share your thoughts?

notes.title: Update - 2025/04/26
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506739/5b3b6386668809b4a9f26ac8e8773717ad8e14d6.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
• Fixed the incorrect positioning of Beatrice’s dialogue box during the battle against Mikail.
• Corrected the turn duration description for the Heart Ability: [b]Righteous Magic[/b].
• Added an experience reward to the side quest: [b]For the Caesar![/b]
• Fixed a dialogue error where Jake fails to recognize the protagonist as a Mongrel.

[b]New Content:[/b]
• [b]Strange Bunny Person[/b] now occasionally offers randomized respec advice at the retraining location.
• Players can now enter the [b]Act III[/b] camp; however, much of the content is still unfinished, so exploration of Act III is not yet fully available.

[b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]
• The [b]optional boss[/b] [b]Chromatic Demon[/b] no longer regenerates health, except in its Flame form.
• Magical skin traits like Stoneskin now only apply to physical-type attacks.
• Regular [b]Atercarapax[/b] demons will no longer use the spell [b]Transformation[/b].

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
• Streamlined the tutorial content at the start of the game.
• Reworded the descriptions for Power Attack and Reckless Power Attack to improve clarity.
• Moved the camp system button on the world map to the bottom-right corner.

[b]Additional Notes:[/b]
• The new PC is still having various issues, so I may need some time to adjust.
• The first side quest of [b]Act III[/b], [b]Arena Champion[/b], has just been completed.

notes.title: 【Developer Notice】Update May Be Delayed – Thank You for Your Understanding!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506739/9fd402e945ccef280f21cfc5736cf5beef302e82.png[/img]
Dear players,

I've run into an unexpected issue — the monitor I use for game development suddenly went haywire and now only displays an eerie, all-green screen (seriously, it's the kind of green that makes you think it caught some sort of digital plague).

To be fair, this PC has served me well for ten years, so maybe it's finally earned its rest. But because of this, the planned update will likely be delayed.

I know this might be a bit disappointing for those of you looking forward to the next patch (though honestly, I'm not sure that many people are waiting XD), and I’m personally really bummed that this sudden mishap is slowing down development.
I’ll do my best to purchase new hardware as soon as possible so I can get back to work!

Thank you so much for your patience and understanding. I’ll post another update here as soon as there’s progress on repairs or development.

Wishing you peace and good vibes — I hope to see you in the game again very soon!

— Developer 渺兔

notes.title: Update - 2025/04/18
notes.content:
[b]Update - 2025/04/18[/b]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
    • Fixed an issue in the book The Eight Schools of Magic where the initial option incorrectly targeted a Psionic spell.
(Thanks to Duyung for the report.)
    • Corrected a typo in the side quest Ghost of Midnight City.
(Thanks to Duyung for the report.)
    • The weapon Fulfun no longer grants Dexterity-based attack bonuses, to resolve conflicts with other equipment. As compensation, it now grants increased Dexterity instead.
(Thanks to 鶴返 for the report.)
[b]New Features:[/b]
    • A new necklace called Jigen Kill has been added to the game. It is intended to help balance the overly dominant dual-wielding builds.
    • A new pair of boots called Gömböc Boots has been added to the game.
    • Side Quest: Your Blood Calls to the Skull Throne now includes a warning before the boss fight to reduce the chance of sudden one-hit defeats.
    • The main quest in Act II, within the Troll Nest, now includes a pre-boss warning to prevent overly sudden combat encounters.
    • Added tutorial messages to help players locate limited-time items.
    • Added entrance and exit indicators during the prologue tutorial stage.
[b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]
    • Rejuvenation status on [b]Reynard Loups[/b] is now exclusive to the highest difficulty setting.
    • Some extra buffs in the Dwarven Ruins and Deimos encounters have been redistributed across higher difficulties.
    • The base cost for retraining has been reduced from 50 to 20.
    • The number of free retrain opportunities has been increased from 3 to 5.
    • Flesh Golem’s Mighty Knockdown has been replaced with a regular Knockdown.
[b]Other Changes:[/b]
    • Further attempts have been made to optimize loading sequences during game start and character creation.
    • Keyboard controls have been removed from the character creation screen.
    • For the [b]Oracle[/b] class, curses that are triggered during combat will now skip their casting animations.
[b]Additional Notes:[/b]
    • None.

notes.title: [RMAsia] “The Land of Rest 1” Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/c378561246253166a081a7a88d391896e6e00f2e.png[/img]
[code]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/RMA]關注RMAsia鑑賞家[/url]
[/code]

[h1]STORY[/h1]
《The Lands of Rest1》 : Part 1 is a story-driven game that narrates the life of Bipara in the Underground Realm.

"In the days of the past, I had a complete family and lived a simple, happy life. However, one day, I lost everything."
A sudden accident took away Bipara’s parents and home. The only thing left behind by his father—the family heirloom, a crystal from the legendary Underground Realm—became his only support.
Guided by this crystal, Bipara arrives in the Underground Realm.

Why did this crystal guide him here in the first place?
The mystery of the story will slowly unfold as the plot progresses —


[h1]DEMO[/h1]
The demo version allows you to play through chapters U0 to U2, with a playtime of approximately 2 hours.

The full version of the game will eventually have 6 chapters (U0 to U5). Below is an estimate of the length for each chapter and the range covered in the demo.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/599246b6c5209708ae57212ae4c6a07f0358c301.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461310/1_Demo/

If you’re interested in the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist. The full version is scheduled for release in Q4 2025 (by the end of the year).

notes.title: Update - 2025/04/12
notes.content:
[b]Update - 2025/04/12[/b]
[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]    • Removed an outdated description related to the Ranger subclass slayer on the character creation screen. This description had become invalid due to version updates.
(Thanks to 鶴返 for the report.)
   • Fixed the skill description for "Stand as one 'gainst the true foe, or meet regret in death." (Thanks to 粽子 for the report.) 
[b]New Features:
[/b]    • The Weapon Master class has been revised. A new mechanic has been introduced: once a player acquires a Master-level weapon specialization, their general weapon specializations will be forgotten. This change is intended to make the character’s initial combat actions feel smoother.
[b]Balance Adjustments:
[/b]    • Wyverns, Controlled Wyverns, Ghouls, and Flesh Golems have had the Battle Frenzy skill removed, reducing their number of attacks.
    • The chance to inflict poison on attacks from all wyvern-type creatures has been reduced.
    • Freedom of Movement no longer grants immunity to Mighty Knockdown.
    • Stone Golems’ Mighty Knockdown has been replaced with a regular Knockdown.
    • The chance for Falling Rocks and Rain of Stones to cause Mighty Knockdown has been slightly reduced.
[b]Other Changes:
[/b]    • Experience bonuses from defeating higher-level enemies have been increased. This change is aimed at better balancing experience gain.
[b]Additional Notes:
[/b]    • None.

notes.title: Update - 2025/04/10
notes.content:
Update - 2025/04/10
[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]    • None.
[b]New Features:
[/b]    • Spell school names now include keyword tooltips.
[b]Balance Adjustments:
[/b]    • Full plate armor now grants additional HP.
[b]Other Changes:
[/b]    • The achievement related to the sealed vampire boss in Act 2 has been changed. It is now awarded before defeating the Master of the Inverted Mage Tower.
[b]Additional Notes:
[/b]    • The experience penalty and growth adjustment system has been reverted to use a 2-level threshold, and its status is now hidden.
If you've played during the previous free test period, please note that the more forgiving system from that time has been rolled back—this wasn’t previously mentioned, and I sincerely apologize for the oversight.
